name: agent-window-semantic-search
description: Local semantic search over every prompt you've sent to Copilot agents — Agents window, Copilot CLI, autopilot and VS Code Chat.

commands.title: Search Prompt History (Including Agent, Skill and System Messages)

enumDescriptions: Copy the prompt to the clipboard
Insert the prompt into the chat input (without sending)
Open the full prompt in a read-only editor
Open or resume the session the prompt came from
awss.defaultAction.description: What Enter does on a search result.

awss.maxResults.description: Maximum results shown in the search picker.

enumDescriptions: Local ONNX model — prompts never leave this machine
Any OpenAI-compatible /embeddings endpoint (Azure OpenAI, Foundry, Ollama, LM Studio). Remote endpoints receive your prompt text.
awss.embedding.provider.markdownDescription: Embedding backend for semantic search. Changing it re-embeds the index in the background.

awss.embedding.model.markdownDescription: Local embedding model. `bge-small-en-v1.5` gave the best retrieval quality on real prompt history; `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` is ~2x faster to index.

awss.embedding.modelDir.markdownDescription: Folder that already contains the model files (for offline machines). Leave empty to use the bundled or cached model.

awss.embedding.allowDownload.markdownDescription: Allow downloading the pinned, hash-verified model from Hugging Face when it is not bundled or cached. Only model files are downloaded; no prompt text is sent.

awss.embedding.threads.description: CPU threads used for local embedding.

awss.embedding.openai.model.description: Model/deployment name for the openai-compatible provider.

awss.embedding.openai.apiKeyEnv.description: Name of an environment variable holding the API key (keys are never stored in settings).

awss.index.directory.markdownDescription: Index location. Empty = a per-user cache folder shared by all VS Code windows (including the Agents window), the CLI and the MCP server.

awss.index.embedOrigins.description: Message origins that get semantic embeddings. Others remain keyword-searchable.

awss.sources.copilot.description: Index Copilot agent sessions (Agents window, Copilot CLI, autopilot).

awss.sources.vscodeChat.description: Index VS Code Chat panel history (Stable and Insiders).

awss.sources.retainDeleted.description: Keep prompts in the index after their session is deleted from disk.

awss.index.backgroundIntervalMinutes.description: How often to pick up new prompts in the background (0 = only when searching).
